h1: Sales reports written in plain language
overview: Numbers without a story do not help. We pull your sales from your store and analytics, check them for gaps and write a short report that says what happened, why it likely happened and what to try next. You choose a weekly or monthly rhythm for the starter sprint. Each report has a few charts, a best and worst products list and three clear actions. Ongoing monthly reports are quoted separately.

faq: Will the report tell me why sales moved?
It lists the most likely reasons, such as a campaign, a stock-out or a price change, based on your data. We label what is certain and what is a guess, because data seldom proves a single cause.
Do you keep sending reports every month?
This service is a fixed starter sprint with the reports listed in your package. Monthly care after that is quoted separately, and we can set up the template so you can produce reports yourself.
What data do you need from me?
Viewer access to your store and analytics, and ad accounts if you want marketing results. If you prefer not to share access, an order export and ad report downloads also work.
Can the report go to my accountant or investors?
Yes, the report is a document you own and can share. It is not a financial statement or tax advice. For accounting numbers, your accountant should check figures against your books.
